jobs.name: gpu
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p babylm/smoke && python -c "import torch,time,pandas,matplotlib; x=torch.randn(8192,8192,device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16); torch.cuda.synchronize(); t=time.time(); [x@x for _ in range(50)]; torch.cuda.synchronize(); print('TFLOPS', 50*2*8192**3/(time.time()-t)/1e12)" | tee babylm/smoke/out.txt && curl -sI https://huggingface.co | head -1 | tee -a babylm/smoke/out.txt
